title: Omori
shortDescription: Omori helps define a Nintendo Switch horror path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Makes a documented horror option easier to find in the Nintendo Switch path.
Keeps third-party commentary and scores out of the linked metadata path.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Logged for the Nintendo Switch horror discovery path using a source-linked Wikidata item; this remains a browsable catalog record, not a score.
